lines.t:
A <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c> several times larger than normal,
ignoring the <c:ffff00>{{tinpet}}<c> standard.
In a <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c>, its <c:ffff00>head<c> and each <c:ffff00>arm<c> count as a
separate <c:ffff00>{{object}}<c>; <c:ffff00>destroying<c> the head leaves it
<c:ffff00>{{knocked_out}}<c>.
It resists these <c:ffff00>actions<c>:
  {{slip}}, {{destroy_game_term}}: extra {{effect}} negated
  {{countdown}}: <c:ffff00>{{negative_status}}<c> negated
  {{static}}: {{damage}} negated
